# Discrete Emergent Gravity (DEG)
# Matteo Pinna — deg-gravity.com
# Last updated: 2026 (v4)

## What is DEG

Discrete Emergent Gravity (DEG) is a theoretical physics research programme investigating whether spacetime, gravity, and part of the Standard Model's structure can be derived from a single Hamiltonian constraint governing Planck-scale discrete constituents called spacetime atoms.

DEG describes the post-condensation universe — from spacetime atom formation onward. The pre-geometric epoch preceding condensation lies outside the single-postulate framework by construction, in the same sense QCD does not derive the electroweak gauge group.

## The single postulate

H = sum_n [ p_n^2 / 2m  -  (alpha_exp / 2) * a_n^2 ] = 0

Spacetime consists of N discrete Planck-scale atoms, each characterised by a size parameter a_n and carrying g = 442 internal quantum states. g = 442 follows from the requirement that the gauge algebra SU(21)×U(1) embeds the Standard Model, given the adjoint-plus-doublet representation choice. The representation choice and the selection of SU(21) carry honest caveats detailed in the manuscript.

## Three calibrated inputs

The programme uses three disclosed, calibrated inputs — not independently derived:
1. alpha_exp^cosm: calibrated to match Lambda_obs (cosmological constant magnitude)
2. epsilon_alpha: Higgs EWSB parameter
3. epsilon_beta: Higgs EWSB parameter

## Key results (6 — derived from the single postulate)

- Higgs boson mass: m_H = 124.8 ± 2.4 GeV, 0.19σ from PDG [two EWSB inputs disclosed]
- Dark energy: w = -1 exactly [exact geometric corollary of the constraint structure]
- Area quantum: Delta_A = 4*ln(442)*l_P^2 ≈ 24.37 l_P^2 [conditional: j=j_min dominance; BH coefficient imported]
- Barbero-Immirzi analogue: gamma_DEG ≈ 2.24 [derived from g=442]
- Page curve: S_rad(k) = min(k, N-k)*ln(442) [exact at leading order, finite-dim Hilbert space]
- WdW unitarity: exact [kinematic from finite-dim Hilbert space]

## Standard Model results

- SM gauge group SU(3)×SU(2)×U(1) derived from SU(21) embedding chain
- Family symmetry SU(3)_fam identified; five-to-three generation reduction [open problem]
- All SM quantum numbers verified from decomposition
- Strong CP: theta_tree = 0 [conditional on NB conditions]
- CKM phase delta_CKM = 1.20 rad [input used to fix phi_DEG]
- Hierarchy: Delta_min = 7.3±0.5, no SUSY required [approximate]
- M_GUT ~ 9×10^14 GeV [provisional]

## Cosmological results

- Flatness Omega = 1 from discrete Hartle-Hawking [derived]
- w = -1 exact geometric corollary; Lambda_obs magnitude is a calibrated input
- w = 1/3 at quantum-classical transition [asserted; physical basis not yet derived]
- MOND acceleration a_0^DEG = 8.6×10^-11 m/s^2 [semi-derived; 28% below observed]
- Tully-Fisher M ∝ v^4 [derived]
- No inflaton required; no gravitino/moduli problem
- All Sakharov conditions structurally present from SU(21)
- eta_B ~ 6×10^-10 reproduced by construction of phi_DEG [not an independent prediction]
- CMB spectral index n_s ≈ 0.963: fossil of pre-geometric phase; not a DEG prediction

## CMB domain-of-validity note

The DEG quantum epoch gives n_s = 4 [asserted]. The observed n_s ≈ 0.963 is a fossil of the pre-geometric phase G̃ ⊃ SU(21)×U(1). Seven internal mechanisms exhausted; one (Euclidean Bessel) under active investigation. Identifying G̃ is the natural next extension.

1. CPT-odd LV eta_1 = 0 | Fermi-LAT/CTA | now
2. No WIMP direct detection | LZ/XENONnT | now
3. w = -1 exactly | DESI/Euclid | 2-5 yr; any 5σ w≠-1 falsifies
4. P(k) two-scale suppression at k~0.4 and k~90 h/Mpc | DESI/Euclid | 2-5 yr
5. Normal neutrino ordering, m_nu1 ~ 10^-5 eV | JUNO | 3-5 yr
6. kappa_V = 0.432 [open tension; ceiling 0.797 analytical] | HL-LHC | ~5 yr
7. nEDM in range 2×10^-53 – 6×10^-40 e·cm | n2EDM@PSI | ~2026
8. Proton decay tau_p ~ 10^33-34 yr [provisional] | Hyper-Kamiokande | 5-10 yr
9. r = 0.00452 ± 0.002 [semi-derived] | CMB-S4/LiteBIRD | ~2032; r > 0.01 falsifies
10. f_NL ≈ 0.0076 null [asserted] | CMB-S4 | ~2032; f_NL > 1 at 2σ falsifies

14. LISA breathing mode: undetectable if a ≳ pm-scale [conditional on unconfirmed a] | LISA | ~2037
15. EMRI phase shift ~10^-82 rad (null) | LISA | ~2037

## Open problems (selected — not a complete list)

- kappa_V = 0.432: 14.2σ at tree level; analytical ceiling 5.1σ (VMD+30%); no path above 0.920; requires DEG-L Group C
- alpha_exp^cosm: calibrated input; multiple derivation mechanisms tested and ruled out; theoretical breakthrough required
- Atomic lattice spacing a: no derivation exists; RG route gives wrong sign; weak lower bound from LISA
- Five-to-three generation reduction: branching rule gives 5 family-triplet copies, not 3; unresolved
- Sterile neutrino mass and leptogenesis: seesaw misses M_R1 target by ~13 orders; standard leptogenesis 5 orders short of L_active needed; Affleck-Dine closes most but residual factor ~6 is fit not derived
- Bekenstein-Hawking coefficient: g_eff=1 gives zero screen entropy, not 1/4; imported assumption
- Galaxy cluster profiles at large r: MOND provides partial screening only; sigma_8 calculation does not reproduce its own stated product
- Spectral index n_s: outside current framework; 7 mechanisms exhausted; 1 under investigation
- Higgs EWSB parameters epsilon_alpha, epsilon_beta: calibrated inputs; Coleman-Weinberg potential does not reproduce them from first principles
- DEG-L lattice: 4 ensemble specs complete; ~10^5 GPU-hours; would sharpen m_H and constrain kappa_V
